query: select jsonb_build_object('schemaGrants',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'role',coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),'privilege',a.privilege_type)) from pg_namespace n cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a left join pg_roles r on r.oid=a.grantee where n.nspname in ('public','private') and (a.grantee=0 or r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role'))),'functionGrants',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'args',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'role',coalesce(r.rolname,'PUBLIC'),'privilege',a.privilege_type)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a left join pg_roles r on r.oid=a.grantee where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.prokind='f' and (a.grantee=0 or r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role')) and not exists(select 1 from pg_depend d where d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')),'columnGrants',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'role',grantee,'privilege',privilege_type)) from information_schema.column_privileges where table_schema='public' and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','service_role')),'views',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',schemaname,'name',viewname,'definition',definition)) from pg_views where schemaname in ('public','private'))) as acl_snapshot;
